title: Canonical DVR coefficient, completion and open comparison models
statement: Fix the prime, finite extension, valuation ring, small pro-etale coefficient categories and adic datum of [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. OpenDvrCoefficientModel consists of finite-constant and limit-projection-normalized coefficient ring isomorphisms and their actual scalar restriction equivalence. OpenDvrCompletionModel records simultaneous quotient towers, normalized total limits, strict K-flat augmentations, the specified Koszul and intrinsic unit equations and the quotient-completeness criterion [def-weil-derived-complete, prop-weil-pbc-koszul-reconstruction, lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. These coefficient and completion structures retain normalized comparisons as fields. The separate OpenDvrOpenModel interface is recorded in its own definition node.

source.place: Tag 0A0E (lemma-derived-completion-koszul), with sites-modules.tex Tag 093M (lemma-completion-flat). Agent completed-coefficient augmentation comparison and open-completeness bridge, extracted arguments 3-4 of the returned item; completed open preservation is the theorem lem-cbc-completed-extension-zero-comparison.
